## Experimental Design

descrive how it is difficult to evaluate security related tools. should sound human. security tools are tough to evaluate because of the nature of security. you can't just run a test and see if it works, you have to simulate attacks and see if it can defend against them. for this reason, the experiments in this chapter are designed to simulate what a real-world mcp tool poisoning and tool shadowing attack could look like and evaluate pysealer's performance in defending against them. there is limited research evaluating the effectiveness of mcp security tools
